faqs.question: What accessories are available for Rötzmeier products?
faqs.answer: A full range covering conversion accessories, such as soaking trays and metering devices, and spare parts, including flame traps, screw caps, taps, and fittings, for the entire Rötzmeier safety container range.

faqs.question: Can a standard safety can be converted into a moistener?
faqs.answer: Yes, using the soaking tray with pump, available for 1-liter (P1) or 2-liter (P2) safety cans.

faqs.question: Can a transportation container be used inside the plant?
faqs.answer: Yes, with the right metering device accessory, since transportation containers ship without a pressure control valve as standard.

faqs.question: How do I find the right flame trap for my product?
faqs.answer: Match your product: FS125 for safety cans, FS150 for canisters and 10 or 25-liter barrels, FS200 for 50-liter barrels, or FSA2 for a 2" adapter fitting.

faqs.question: How do I replace a worn screw cap or tap?
faqs.answer: Confirm the thread size and function you need; caps and taps are available as individual spare parts, including versions specific to transportation cans (K126) and transportation containers (K152).

faqs.question: How long are spare parts available after purchase?
faqs.answer: Rötzmeier states spare parts remain available for many years after your original purchase.

faqs.question: What is a washing cage used for?
faqs.answer: It supports component cleaning as part of routine maintenance, alongside the washing tank.

faqs.question: What is a funnel inlay filter?
faqs.answer: A replaceable filter component for safety funnels, including its spring ring, order number TES.

faqs.question: I can't find the specific part I need. What should I do?
faqs.answer: Contact Inkarp directly. Rötzmeier's own guidance is that any article not obviously listed is still worth asking about.

faqs.question: What is the price of Rötzmeier Accessories in India?
faqs.answer: The price depends on which accessory or spare part you need. Contact Inkarp for a quotation once your requirement is confirmed.

longForm.heroLead: Two things happen to a well-built safety container over its working life: your needs change, or a part wears out. This range covers both. A soaking tray turns a standard safety can into a moistener, without buying a separate product. A metering device lets a transportation container work inside the plant too, not just on the road. And when a flame trap, cap, or tap needs replacing, the exact match is here: FS125 for safety cans, FS150 for canisters and the smaller barrels, FS200 for the 50-liter barrel. Rötzmeier states spare parts stay available for many years after purchase.

sections.description: Everything you need to find the right accessory or spare part: how conversion accessories add new function to what you own, which flame trap and closure part fits which product, and Inkarp installation and service support.

body: A soaking tray converts a standard safety can into a moistener; a metering device lets a transportation container also serve in-plant use.
Every flame trap has a confirmed match. FS125 for safety cans, FS150 for canisters and 10/25-liter barrels, FS200 for 50-liter barrels, FSA2 for 2" adapter fittings.
Caps and taps are replaceable individually. Screw caps, self-closing taps, and metering devices are all available as standalone spare parts, not tied to buying a whole new container.
Parts stay available long after the purchase. Rötzmeier states spare parts remain in supply for many years, supporting equipment already in service.
Coverage spans the whole range. Accessories and spares exist for safety cans, canisters, barrels, transportation containers, and funnels.

If something's hard to find, that's a direct question, not a dead end. Rötzmeier's own guidance is to contact them directly for any article that isn't obviously listed, and Inkarp carries that same commitment locally.

sections.title: Conversion Accessories: New Function From What You Already Own
body: Some accessories in this range don't replace anything. They give an existing product a second job.

The soaking tray with pump turns a standard 1 or 2-liter safety can into a moistener, matching the function of the dedicated SP1 and SP2 moistener products without needing to buy one separately. The same logic applies to metering devices for transportation containers: since a transportation container ships without a pressure control valve as standard, adding the right accessory brings in-plant dispensing capability to a container that was originally built for the road.
